d: Short, shaggy ash-grey hair with choppy bangs falls over a youthful, adolescent face with large, silver-grey eyes and a slight smile. The build is slender, dressed in a white tactical jacket with a grey fur collar, a grey under-shirt, a blue necktie, and a black crossbody chest rig over a white shirt. Signature details include a white cracked mask pushed up onto the head, a black headset with a microphone, a black choker, and a small white creature perched on the shoulder.
